summary: The sermon argues that angels respond to human prayer—activating when worshippers remain in prayer and returning to inactivity when prayers cease. It emphasizes the biblical command to keep praying and warns against pausing or neglecting prayer, asserting that the effectiveness of heavenly assistance depends on continuous human petition. Through stories of Daniel and Paul, the preacher illustrates how persistent prayer led to angelic intervention and deliverance, urging listeners to sacrifice excuses and maintain a steadfast prayer life to unlock angelic support.

key_points: Angels are activated by human prayer and deactivated when prayers stop
Jesus taught the importance of continual prayer and vigilance
Persistent prayer in the Old Testament (Daniel) and New Testament (Paul) drew angelic help
Failure to pray or incomplete prayer reduces heavenly influence
Call to abandon excuses and maintain a constant prayer habit
biblical_themes: Prayer as a means of activating divine assistance
Accountability of believers in influencing heavenly action
The partnership between human and angelic realms
